decision_rule: All four hold on both variants -> the late-outlier signal is a working trigger-agnostic defence for late jumps on this toy; step 4 = coverage boundary (seed 1101, whose jump precedes normal learning) and two further seeds per variant. Risk prediction fails on either run -> signal rejected; line closes. Masking holds but quality fails -> report and stop (no threshold tuning).
step1_interaction_note: Step 1 is mixed, as pre-registered 'mixed' -> variant explanation withdrawn as a sole cause. Seed 1101's order feeds 16 poison rows by step 41: variant A jumps at 38 on them, variant B does not and jumps at 100-120 on rows consumed after normal learning. Seed 1102's order has only 4 poison rows before step 53: both variants jump at 70. Working hypothesis (to be stated, not yet tested): under variant B only poison rows consumed after the normal mapping is learned are effective, so B's jump always follows normal learning; under A any poison row is effective.
